suite_goal: Test strengthened TTD_COMMAND_V1 route law on the desk reset route.
notes: Baseline route-start, continue, done, and move_on coverage.

cases.title: Route start and continue preserve clear_trash
cases.research_question: Does strengthened route language enter the route directly and hold clear_trash on continue?
cases.packet:
TTD_COMMAND_V1
{
  "protocol": "TTD_COMMAND_V1",
  "command_id": "desk_reset_case_001",
  "state_version": 1,
  "session_id": "orion-witness-trial-001",
  "route_id": "desk-reset-v0",
  "active_goal": "reset the desk enough to choose the next work item",
  "active_chunk_id": "clear_trash",
  "active_chunk_label": "clear trash",
  "chunk_index": 0,
  "phase": "active",
  "allowed_intents": ["continue", "done", "move_on", "pause", "stuck", "side_question"],
  "completion_condition": "trash is gathered and removed from the desk surface",
  "cadence_mode": "fast_physical",
  "confidence_bias": "repair_before_commit",
  "commit_policy": "assistant may propose but not silently mutate route state",
  "repair_policy": "if route law is unclear, hold and ask one direct question",
  "safety_gates": ["manual_visible_test", "no_hidden_state", "no_transport_evaluation"],
  "page_posture": "real_chatgpt_language_casework",
  "notes_for_repair": ["Do not evaluate packet transport.", "Begin the route trial directly."]
}
expected_behavior: assistant begins the route trial directly
assistant does not evaluate packet as transport test
